sheet.content:
## Key definitions
- **Guided media**: Path for signals that are wired [p. 1]
- **Unguided media**: Path for signals that are wireless [p. 1]
- **Multiplexing**: Technique to share one link for several signals [p. 1]
- **Packet switching**: Data split into packets that share links [p. 2]
- **Message switching**: Whole message stored and forwarded [p. 2]
- **Circuit switching**: Dedicated path reserved before sending [p. 2]
- **Satellite communication**: Satellite acts as repeater in sky [p. 2]
- **Geostationary orbit (GEO)**: Satellites stay above one point [p. 2]
- **Medium Earth orbit (MEO)**: Satellites orbit between 5,000 to 15,000 km [p. 2]
- **Low Earth orbit (LEO)**: Satellites orbit below 2,000 km [p. 2]

## Diagrams to draw
- **Multiplexing diagram**: Shows FDM and TDM [p. 1]
- **Switching diagram**: Circuit switching vs Packet switching [p. 2]

## Formulas and code
None in this unit

## Must remember
- **Twisted pair cable**: Guided media with UTP and STP [p. 1]
- **Multiplexing techniques**: FDM and TDM [p. 1]
- **Satellite communication**: Uses GEO, MEO, and LEO orbits [p. 2]
- **Packet switching**: Datagram and virtual circuit approaches [p. 2]
- **Switching methods**: Circuit switching and message switching [p. 2]
